mapper.select: select su.sys_id, su.user_id, su.user_nm, su.user_password, su.password_fail_cnt, su.init_yn, su.email_valid_yn, su.plant_cd as sys_plant_cd , su.user_role from sys_user su where 1=1 and su.user_id = #{userId} and su.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: update sys_user set password_fail_cnt = password_fail_cnt + 1 where 1=1 and sys_id = #{sysId}
update sys_user set password_fail_cnt = 0 where 1=1 and sys_id = #{sysId}
update sys_user set user_password = #{initPwdRequest.password}, password_fail_cnt = 0, init_yn = 'N' where 1=1 and user_id = #{userId} and su.delete_yn = 'N'
